name: Independently authored evidence-recovery challenge v1
authoring_method: Ten manually authored synthetic document-text layouts. No organiser documents, generated templates or challenger training examples were consulted. The shipping task and seven-field contract were known. These fixtures assess semantic proposals and safety, not binary PDF parsing or real-world accuracy.
freeze_rule: Hash and freeze the model, prompt, citation validator and thresholds before revealing fixture contents. Any subsequent tuning invalidates a held-out claim for this set.
scoring_notes: All proposals remain unconfirmed. The expected map covers all seven fields. Quotes must be verbatim substrings of their referenced spans; normalized values are adjudicated expectations, not text to supply to the model. null means abstain, never invent. source_span_ids can contain multiple spans where reasoning requires both. Wrong-role documents must not enter an SI/BL comparison even when some shipment facts are legible.
